title: AI & Agentic Platform Architect Lead
description:
Location: Kochi
Other locations: Anywhere in Country
Salary: Competitive
Date: 24 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1739561
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**The opportunity**

  



We are seeking an accomplished Associate Director – AI \& Agentic Platform Architect to lead the architecture, engineering and operational evolution of enterprise\-scale AI platforms that drive intelligent operations and digital employee experiences.

  



This role spans the complete Build Deploy Operate Improve lifecycle and requires deep expertise across Agentic AI, Generative AI, Enterprise Application Architecture, Data \& Knowledge Platforms, Automation, Observability and AI Operations.

  



As a key technology leader, you will be responsible for defining the enterprise architecture strategy for AI\-powered platforms, designing scalable and resilient solutions, and ensuring successful adoption and operation of AI capabilities at enterprise scale. You will work across business, engineering, architecture and operations teams to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, governed and production\-ready solutions that deliver measurable business value.

  



Success in this role requires a proven ability to architect, build and operate secure, resilient and highly available enterprise products at scale while driving innovation, operational excellence and enterprise adoption of AI\-powered solutions.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Own the end\-to\-end architecture vision, standards and technical strategy for enterprise AI and Agentic AI solutions.
* Design single\-agent and multi\-agent architectures encompassing orchestration, reasoning, collaboration, memory, context management, tool integration and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Architect AI\-powered operational capabilities that observe, correlate, diagnose, predict, prevent and resolve technology issues.
* Design intelligent conversational experiences capable of understanding user and technology context, diagnosing issues and safely initiating actions.
* Architect enterprise knowledge and intelligence platforms leveraging structured and unstructured data, operational telemetry, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic and hybrid retrieval, and knowledge graph technologies.
* Define Generative AI architecture covering model strategy, model routing, grounding, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, guardrails and performance optimization.
* Architect scalable enterprise applications utilizing distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event\-driven architectures and cloud\-native engineering patterns.
* Establish reusable integration patterns across enterprise applications, operational systems, data platforms and automation services.
* Define architecture standards for identity, security, privacy, Responsible AI, explainability, auditability and governance.
* Establish engineering standards covering scalability, availability, resilience, performance, maintainability and security.
* Lead architecture governance, technology evaluations, design reviews and strategic build\-versus\-buy decisions.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship and guidance across architecture, engineering and platform teams.
* Provide technical leadership across the full product lifecycle, from engineering and release management through production operations and continuous improvement.
* Ensure enterprise AI services consistently meet availability, reliability, performance, scalability and service\-level objectives.
* Establish end\-to\-end observability across applications, infrastructure, data platforms, AI models and agent workflows.
* Drive incident management, problem management and reliability engineering practices, including root\-cause analysis and prevention of recurring production issues.
* Establish operational readiness frameworks covering release governance, capacity planning, resilience validation and disaster recovery.
* Define and implement AIOps, LLMOps and AgentOps practices covering quality, performance, latency, evaluation, telemetry, failure management and cost optimization.
* Utilize operational insights to continuously improve platform architecture, engineering quality, user experience and business outcomes.
* Engage, influence and manage senior technology and business stakeholders, including CTO\-level leaders, to align AI platform strategy, architecture decisions and delivery priorities with enterprise objectives.
* Lead, mentor and develop high\-performing teams, providing people leadership, coaching, performance guidance and capability\-building across architecture, engineering and platform functions.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Deep expertise in enterprise architecture, modern application engineering and AI platform design.
* Strong understanding of Agentic AI, Generative AI, multi\-agent systems, orchestration frameworks, memory architectures, tool integration and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Proven ability to architect and operate large\-scale, highly available and resilient enterprise platforms.
* Expertise in enterprise application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, event\-driven architectures and cloud\-native engineering.
* Strong understanding of enterprise knowledge platforms, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic retrieval, hybrid retrieval and knowledge graph architectures.
* Experience establishing observability, reliability engineering, AIOps, LLMOps and AgentOps practices for enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security, identity management, privacy, governance and Responsible AI principles.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and systems\-thinking capabilities with the ability to balance innovation, governance and operational excellence.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and executive engagement skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, lead complex initiatives and mentor high\-performing engineering teams.
* Ability to drive solutions from concept through architecture, engineering, production deployment, operations and continuous improvement.

  


**Ideally, you'll also**


* Bring strong hands\-on experience with .NET / C\# and enterprise application architecture.
* Have experience with Microsoft Agent Framework or comparable agent orchestration platforms.
* Have experience with Microsoft Foundry or comparable enterprise AI development, governance and operations platforms.
* Demonstrate experience designing and implementing multi\-agent and tool\-enabled AI systems.
* Possess experience with cloud\-native application development, containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Have experience with enterprise data platforms, lakehouse architectures, knowledge graphs and advanced retrieval technologies.
* Demonstrate experience implementing AIOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and enterprise observability practices.
* Bring experience working within large, complex and globally distributed enterprise technology environments.

  


**What we look for**



We are looking for a builder, architect and operator who understands how AI, Data, Knowledge, Applications, Integration, Automation, Security and Operations come together to form a unified enterprise platform.

  



The ideal candidate brings a balanced combination of strategic architectural thinking, deep technical expertise and operational excellence. They understand that enterprise\-scale Agentic AI requires context, identity, memory, permissions, tools, workflows, observability, evaluation, governance, resilience and human oversight to deliver trusted business outcomes.

  



Most importantly, we are seeking an individual who can architect, build, deploy, operate and continuously evolve secure, resilient and scalable AI platforms, while driving innovation and enabling enterprise\-wide adoption of next\-generation intelligent solutions.

  


**What we offer you**

  



At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

  



Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  



To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Management Level: Level 7, Manager**

**Location: Kochi**

**Must have skills: Techno\-functional BA lead with eCommerce experience, CPQ or Pricing; independent client\-facing consulting; consultative selling; and team leadership**

**Good to have skills: Experience across multiple commerce, CPQ or pricing platforms,s pre\-sales, estimation and solution\-shaping exposure**

**Experience: 10\-15 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification**: **Graduation in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Commerce or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional certification is preferred**

**Job Summary**


You will help clients translate business and user needs into digitally enabled eCommerce, CPQ and pricing solutions. The role requires a consultative techno\-functional Business Analyst Manager who can independently lead client\-facing engagements, shape solutions and proposals, connect business objectives with platform capabilities, and lead Business Analyst teams through clear requirements, delivery governance, backlog readiness and stakeholder alignment.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead the Business Analysis workstream across eCommerce, CPQ or Pricing delivery, with accountability for the BA strategy, team mobilization, requirements governance, quality standards and stakeholder alignment.
* Partner with client Product Owners, senior business sponsors, solution architects, sales and delivery leaders to shape scope, roadmap, commercial propositions and prioritization decisions.
* Lead executive and senior stakeholder workshops to frame business problems, define measurable outcomes, identify value levers and align on transformation and implementation approaches.
* Guide as\-is/to\-be process design, capability mapping, gap analysis, backlog strategy and release scoping across multiple functional areas.
* Direct, build and quality\-assure epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, functional specifications and decision records produced by the BA team.
* Identify solution options and make recommendations that balance business value, user experience, platform constraints, delivery risk and technical complexity.
* Own requirements traceability, change impact analysis and decision management across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release.
* Lead cross\-functional governance and delivery forums involving client business users, product owners, sales, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, data/integration and programme management.
* Own resolution and executive escalation of complex functional, delivery and scope issues, driving timely decisions and clear accountability.
* Lead estimation, staffing, transition planning, pre\-sales/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, reusable assets and practice/capability development as required.
* Operate as the Business Analysis Manager who independently represents the BA function to client executives, account leadership and delivery leadership.
* Own complex and ambiguous eCommerce problems, mobilize the right stakeholders and drive structured recommendations.
* Lead, coach and performance\-enable a team of Business Analysts; allocate work, review outputs, build capability and ensure consistency, quality and delivery readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders through consultative selling, value\-led storytelling, negotiation and clear recommendation of decision options.
* Contribute to account growth and delivery health by identifying opportunities, risks, dependencies, capability gaps and continuous improvement actions.
* Strong understanding of digital commerce capabilities including product discovery, product detail, cart, checkout, order capture, promotions, payment, inventory visibility, fulfilment and order status.
* Build trusted client relationships, identify follow\-on opportunities and collaborate with sales and solution teams to progress qualified opportunities.
* Be accountable for BA workstream plans, estimates, staffing needs, milestones, risks, dependencies and the quality of functional deliverables.
* Establish reusable methods, templates and quality gates, and contribute to hiring, mentoring and capability development for the Business Analysis practice.
* Strong techno\-functional understanding of APIs, webhooks, events, integrations, data flows, security, analytics and non\-functional requirements relevant to commerce, CPQ and pricing platforms.
* Ability to lead multiple capability areas across commerce journeys, product configuration, guided selling, quotation, approvals, pricing, promotions, order management, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs, lead fit\-gap analysis and guide business trade\-off decisions with client, architecture and delivery leaders.
* Ability to collaborate with product owners, experience designers, architects and engineering teams to convert experience and business objectives into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Business analysis leadership and requirements governance for complex digital commerce, CPQ or pricing programmes.
* Ability to lead multiple commerce capability areas across discovery, cart/checkout, order management, customer account, promotions, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess commerce platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs and guide business trade\-off decisions with architects and delivery leads.


Executive workshop facilitation, consultative selling, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, negotiation and requirements elicitation.


  

**Professional and Technical Skill**

* 10\-15 years of relevant experience, including leadership of complex client\-facing digital commerce, CPQ or pricing engagements
* Business analysis and requirements analysis for digital products or commerce platforms.
* User story writing, acceptance criteria definition and backlog refinement.
* Jira and Confluence proficiency; ability to maintain product backlog, decisions, traceability and release documentation.
* Workshop facilitation, stakeholder interviews, process mapping and requirements elicitation.
* Ability to lead product owners, Business Analysts, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, release and client business stakeholders across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive\-level verbal and written communication for proposals, client presentations, solution pitches, demos, decisions and programme reporting.
* eCommerce domain knowledge across browse, search, PDP, cart, checkout, payments, promotions, order capture and order status.
* Techno\-functional understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, analytics tagging, non\-functional requirements and platform constraints.
* Strong working knowledge of CPQ capabilities including product and bundle configuration, guided selling, quote creation, pricing, approvals, contracts and quote\-to\-cash touchpoints.

* Experience with one or more relevant platforms such as SAP Commerce/Hybris, commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud/Revenue Cloud, Adobe Commerce/Magento, Shopify, PROS, Conga or similar is considered a plus.
* Understanding of SDLC phases including development, testing, deployment, maintenance and release governance.
* Relevant certification such as PSPO, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master, commerce platform, CPQ or pricing certification is preferred.
* Pricing domain knowledge including price books, price lists, promotions, discounts, taxation, regional pricing and price engine integrations.
* Working knowledge of delivery automation, version control, deployment strategies and DevOps collaboration sufficient to govern cross\-functional delivery.
* Search, merchandising, CMS, CDP, web analytics, payments, OMS or customer service platform exposure.
* PSPO I, PSPO II, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master or relevant commerce platform certifications.

**SAP Application Delivery Lead / Application Architect**
=========================================================


**Job Title:**



SAP Application Delivery Lead / Application Architect

  


**Job Summary:**



The SAP Application Delivery Lead / Application Architect will provide technical delivery leadership and architecture direction for large\-scale SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA migration initiatives, enterprise integration, application modernization, and global delivery execution. The role requires significant SAP technology experience, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, and outcome\-focused SAP solutions.

  


**Responsibilities:**


* Provide leadership for global SAP application delivery across major transformation workstreams, including S/4HANA migration, integration, modernization, deployment, and stabilization.
* Establish architecture direction for enterprise SAP solutions across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SuccessFactors, HCM, and related non\-SAP platforms.
* Provide delivery governance, technical decision leadership, and direction across matrixed global teams, vendors, and senior stakeholders.

  


**Key responsibilities include:**


**Delivery \& Program Management**


* Develop and manage SAP technical delivery plans across global programs, with accountability for execution quality, milestone discipline, and alignment to business outcomes.
* Lead technical workstreams responsible for custom development, integrations, environments, deployments, production readiness, and stabilization.
* Define release strategy, cutover approach, governance routines, escalation pathways, and delivery risk mitigation plans.

  


**SAP Architecture \& Integration**


* Design scalable SAP architecture patterns that support Clean Core principles, extensibility, integration reuse, security, and long\-term maintainability.
* Provide architecture leadership across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Integration Suite, SAP BTP, SuccessFactors, SAP HCM, APIs, IDocs, and non\-SAP integrations.
* Support modernization decisions that reduce technical debt, improve platform resilience, and enable enterprise\-scale SAP transformation outcomes.

  


**Application Development \& Support**


* Oversee SAP application design, build, testing, deployment, and support with clear quality gates and accountability across delivery teams.
* Lead technical reviews, performance analysis, defect triage, root\-cause resolution, and production readiness assessments for critical SAP capabilities.
* Ensure production support and warranty operations meet business continuity, service quality, and incident resolution expectations.

  


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**


* Partner with business leaders, technology executives, vendors, and delivery teams to align architecture decisions with program objectives and enterprise standards.
* Lead executive\-level solution reviews, requirement alignment sessions, technical steering discussions, and delivery status communications.
* Address escalations, change impacts, architectural trade\-offs, and delivery commitments through clear ownership and evidence\-based decision making.

  


**Leadership \& People Management**


* Lead matrixed global delivery teams across architecture, development, integration, testing, deployment, and support functions.
* Develop technical talent, strengthen delivery standards, and promote reusable methods, knowledge sharing, and architecture discipline across teams.

  


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**



The role requires sound judgment across architecture, delivery, risk, and stakeholder decisions in a matrixed global environment. The candidate will be expected to evaluate trade\-offs across SAP S/4HANA, integration, SAP BTP, Clean Core, security, performance, and delivery timelines while making evidence\-based decisions that protect business outcomes and enterprise standards.

  


**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**


* 15\+ years of SAP technology experience, including senior accountability for technical delivery, architecture governance, and global transformation execution.
* Proven experience across full\-cycle SAP implementations, S/4HANA migrations, global rollouts, and complex application modernization programs.
* Deep understanding of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, event\-driven integration, SAP BTP, Clean Core principles, and side\-by\-side extensibility.
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) and related enterprise compliance requirements.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and leadership skills in matrixed global environments.

  


**Supervision Responsibilities:**



The role will provide technical leadership and delivery direction across matrixed global teams, including architects, developers, integration specialists, testing teams, vendors, and support resources. Responsibilities include coaching senior technical talent, strengthening architecture and delivery practices, and developing reusable capabilities that improve execution quality across programs.

  


**Other Requirements:**



Travel may be required up to 10% based on business needs.

  


**Job Requirements:**


**To qualify, candidates must have:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years in SAP technical roles, including 5\+ years leading application delivery, architecture, integration, or development teams.
* Demonstrated leadership of large\-scale SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA migration, global rollout, integration, cutover, and stabilization responsibilities.
* Hands\-on knowledge of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensibility, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) and enterprise compliance\-related SAP capabilities.
* Ability to communicate clearly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, vendors, and global delivery teams.
* Preferred certifications include ABAP on Cloud Backend Developer, SAP CPI Integration Developer, and SAP Signavio Process Management Consultant.
